newer_changes_search: Re-review. No ADIP continuation order for 2026-31 found. Both earlier blockers resolved: the §7.01 income bands are now in en and hi with a quoted fact, and the rules are 'guidance' or 'uncertain' with the end of the period disclosed in how_to_apply.

findings.note: §6 notes (e) and (f) allow aids for children under 40% on joint certification (CWSN).
§6 accepts an Aadhaar enrolment ID and other income proofs such as BPL or MGNREGA cards.
